summary: Birmingham controlled airspace deactivated and aerodrome closed at EGBB, Monday to Friday 2330 to 0600, for winter maintenance.
text:
BIRMINGHAM CTA/CTR DEACTIVATED. ATC CLSD. AD CLSD. PILOTS ARE TO 
MAKE BLIND TRANSMISSIONS WHEN LEAVING THE LATERAL CONFINES OF THE 
CTR/CTA. CLOSURE DUE TO AIRFIELD WINTER MAINT. AIP SUPPLEMENT 
110/2026 REFERS.
